messages:
Ravi: Dropping the small prototype for the 'threshold banner' that appears when SLO target would be ignored to keep min capacity. Quick feedback needed: placement (above slider vs reserved slot), wording, and keyboard behavior.

Ellen: Prefer reserved slot under header so it never causes layout jumps. If we show inline, keyboard users lose context. Also wording: current 'Override active' is vague. Maybe 'Min capacity enforced: autoscale may exceed SLO target.'

Maya: Wording nit: avoid technical phrasing. Try 'Keeping minimum capacity active; target latency may be higher.' Short and user-facing. Also add a 'Why?' link that opens docs in new tab.

Theo: Accessibility: banner should be announced via aria-live polite but not steal focus. Pre-mount a role=status element and update text. Also ensure banner has 4.5:1 contrast and the close control is keyboard reachable.

a11y-bot: Quick scan: banner text contrast 3.6:1, close button hit area 28px (fail), aria-live region missing on prototype. Slider handles missing aria-valuetext.

Ravi: Good catches. Plan: move banner into reserved area, update copy to Maya's suggestion, add aria-live pre-mounted status, and increase close hit area to 44px. For keyboard, pressing Tab should not jump to banner unless user explicitly tabs to it.

Ellen: Also make the stepper a proper spinbutton with aria-valuetext including 'Estimated cost +$X/mo' when changed. Screen reader will then read both value and cost delta.

Maya: UX note: when users hold keys to adjust stepper, debounce cost requests 350ms and show inline 'Calculating...' so users don't think UI froze. Add a small spinner in the reserved slot.

Theo: For motion: any pulsing or attention animation on banner must respect prefers-reduced-motion. Add numeric readouts for screen readers: 'Current latency: 420ms. Guardrail: 300ms. Target: 120ms.'

Ravi: I'll update Figma and open a draft PR with the aria-live patch, spinbutton attrs, and contrast fixes. We'll run a quick keyboard/a11y pass before merging.

Ellen: Thanks 44d

a11y-bot: Scheduled re-scan after PR #1387 lands.
